title: margayi sarwar ki behen haaye haaye
body:
margayi sarwar ki behen haaye haaye
zainabe paabande mehen haaye haaye
jab ke shaheed aah hue the hussain
baandhi thi baazu me rasan haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke bazaro me dar dar phiri
kya na sahi ranjo mehen haaye haaye
pusht pe zalim ka pada belcha
phat na pada charqe kohan haaye haaye
